headline: HBR Realty Agrees to R$938 Million Sale of Shopping Mall Stakes
summary: Brazilian developer HBR Realty (HBRE3) has entered an agreement to sell stakes in several shopping malls for R$938 million, with the transaction expected to close by November 11, 2026.
why: HBR Realty is a significant player in the Brazilian commercial real estate market. Asset divestments of this scale are key to understanding the company's capital allocation and liquidity strategy.

impacts.name: HBR Realty
impacts.why: The sale of assets for nearly R$1 billion provides significant liquidity to the company.
